caption: The drawing depicts a tall grandfather clock with a wooden case that is a rich reddish-brown color. The clock stands upright and consists of three main sections: the base, the long narrow body with a door in the center, and the upper portion housing the clock face. The base is rectangular with a slight overhang at the top and bottom. The central section features a vertically elongated rectangular door with a curved arch at the top, set within a simple frame. The upper section of the clock, which is wider than the body, has decorative elements, including columns on either side and three ornate finials on top. The clock face is circular and set within a square or slightly arched gold-toned background, displaying clock hands and various markings. The sides of the upper section also feature curved wooden elements extending downward, adding a sculptural detail to the piece. The overall composition is centered on the page, and the background is a plain, neutral light color with no additional objects or patterns visible.
title: Grandfather Clock
